question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who looks at the dark side of life
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pessimist"** refers to someone who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen. (निराशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the team's best efforts, the pessimist in the group always expected them to lose.
 
 
 
• **"Optimist" **refers to someone who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something. (आशावादी)
 
 
• **Example: **An optimist would look at a half-filled glass and say it is half full.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that **'Pessimist' **is the one **who looks at the dark side of life.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Physicist **(भौतिक विज्ञानी): A scientist who specializes in the field of physics.

 
 
• **Example:** Albert Einstein was a renowned **physicist** known for his theory of relativity.
 
 
 
• **Optimist **(आशावादी): Someone who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future.
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the challenges, she remained an** optimist** and believed things would get better.
 
 
 
• **Idealist** (आदर्शवादी): A person who is guided more by ideals than by practical considerations.
 
 
• **Example:** As an** idealist,** he always believed in the possibility of a utopian society.
